newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade, dealers said on Friday.

They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. Commerce Department's October business inventories data, which is forecast to rise 0.2 percent compared with a 0.1 percent gain reported in September.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh factors. Some people are waiting for fresh clues to market direction from tonight's release of the (U.S. October) business inventories figures," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact as the numbers have been built into the market and most people have squared or are squaring their positions for the weekend," he said.
In day-to-day rates, weekend eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-1/4 5-1/8 percent.
Monday/Tuesday and Tuesday/Wednesday were unchanged from Thursday's common 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8, six-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent. -- P.Theseira (65-870-3085)
